value.rationale: The 5-by-5 square is the first canonical square rook complex with intrinsic 3-torsion. Its free cyclic quotient displays prime-3 and prime-5 torsion in adjacent degrees and, more structurally, an explicit fixed mod-5 degree-three cup class in the complete absence of rational S5-invariant degree-three classes. This exact symmetry-versus-coefficient distinction is a mathematically motivated finite classification rather than a numerical parameter sweep.
